q: Yoccoz puzzle pieces are used to study local connectivity of Julia sets. They are defined using:
opts: Preimages of external rays landing at specific angles, creating a partition of the plane
exp: Yoccoz puzzles partition the plane into puzzle pieces using preimages of external rays and equipotentials. The tableaux of these pieces reveal whether the Julia set is locally connected at the critical point (Yoccoz's local connectivity theorem for non-renormalizable quadratics).
